summary: Nature Glow Ayurvedic store website with a Ken Burns hero animation using a herbs & spices image, prominently displaying the 'Nature Glow' website name over the animated hero image.
architectural_notes: Project name is 'Nature Glow' — an Ayurvedic store website
Hero section uses a user-uploaded herbs & spices image with Ken Burns (pan/zoom) animation
imageRequirements:
## Edit Images
- Crop and optimize the uploaded herbs and spices flat-lay photo showing a mortar and pestle with turmeric, ginger, rosemary, garlic, cinnamon, and lemon on a wooden table, suitable for a full-screen hero background (hero-herbs-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg)

existing_features.title: Save the uploaded herbs and spices image (mortar & pestle with turmeric, ginger, rosemary, garlic, cinnamon on a wooden table) as the hero background image at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-herbs-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg and use it as the Ken Burns animated background in the Hero component, replacing any previously used hero image.

Apply a Ken Burns CSS animation (smooth continuous slow pan and zoom) to the hero background image in the Hero component, so the herbs and spices image gently moves across the viewport in a cinematic loop.

Display the 'Nature Glow' website name prominently as an overlay text on the hero section, positioned so it is clearly visible over the Ken Burns animated herbs and spices background. Style it with a large, elegant serif font (Playfair Display), white or cream color with a subtle text shadow, so it remains legible as the image moves beneath it.

new_feature_requests.summary: Ken Burns hero animation using uploaded herbs & spices image with 'Nature Glow' name visible overlay
